t: What Does The Name Neide Mean?
s: The name Neide is primarily of Portuguese and Brazilian origin, derived from the Greek mythological figure of the Nereids (Νηρηΐδες), the fifty sea nymphs who were daughters of the sea god Nereus. The name literally means "sea nymph" or "daughter of Nereus," connecting it to oceanic and aquatic symbolism.
